description: Error categories emitted by kraken-cli. Agents should route on the error field, not message strings.

usage_errors.description: Argument and flag errors caught by the CLI parser (unknown flags, values outside a parameter's documented set) exit 2. When -o json was requested, stdout carries a validation error envelope and stderr is empty; otherwise usage text goes to stderr.
usage_errors.agent_action: Validate argument values against each command's `input_schema` (enum, type, required) in tool-catalog.json before invoking. On exit 2 with -o json, parse the validation envelope on stdout, fix the arguments, and re-run; without -o json, read stderr.

fields.error: Error category string (matches a category below)
fields.message: Human-readable error detail (not stable, do not parse)

extended_fields.suggestion: Actionable guidance: tier limits, per-endpoint costs, recommended alternatives
extended_fields.retryable: Boolean indicating the agent may retry after adjusting behavior
extended_fields.docs_url: Link to the relevant Kraken rate limit documentation page

example_rate_limit.message: Spot REST API rate limit exceeded (EAPI:Rate limit exceeded).

refusal_fields.refusal: Which gate refused: allocation_budget, over_allocated, or unverified
refusal_fields.funding: allocation_budget only: the asset the order spends (a pair leg)
refusal_fields.available: allocation_budget only: ledger balance free of reservations, decimal string
refusal_fields.required: allocation_budget only: what the order needs, decimal string
refusal_fields.reconciled: allocation_budget only: false means available may be stale
refusal_fields.backing: over_allocated/unverified only: the allocation set against the real balance

example_refusal.message: Validation error: Insufficient USD in live workspace 'prod': available 3.4844, required 4. The workspace spends only its own allocation ledger; reduce the order or cancel resting orders to free reserves.

categories.description: Kraken API returned an application-level error (insufficient funds, unknown pair, order minimum not met).
categories.agent_action: Log the error. Fix request parameters. Do not retry the same request.

categories.description: Authentication failed. API key invalid, expired, or lacks permissions.
Network-level failure. The request could not reach the Kraken API, or it may have reached it and no usable answer came back.
categories.agent_action: Read `verify_first`. Without it, nothing was sent or the call was a read: retry with exponential backoff and check connectivity. With `"verify_first": true`, an order, cancel, withdrawal, transfer or Earn move may already have executed, and the CLI does not resend it: check its state first. Spot orders: `kraken open-orders` and `kraken closed-orders` (match on `--cl-ord-id` or `--userref`), then `kraken trades-history` (match on the `ordertxid` from `kraken closed-orders`). Futures orders: `kraken futures open-orders`, `kraken futures fills`, `kraken futures history-orders`. Withdrawals and transfers: `kraken withdrawal status`, `kraken ledgers`, `kraken futures transfers`. Earn allocations: compare `amount_allocated.total.native` and `amount_allocated.pending.native` for the same `strategy_id` in `kraken earn allocations` with the values recorded before the call (a missing `pending`, or a strategy that is not listed, counts as zero), and check `kraken ledgers`; `kraken earn allocate-status` and `kraken earn deallocate-status` only say whether a known move is still pending. Send it again only if it is absent everywhere. The message prose restates the verdict ('verify its state before retrying') for older parsers.
common_causes: No answer within 30s after sending (mutating calls: verify_first)

example_envelope.message: Network error: AddOrder got no usable response (error sending request for url (https://api.kraken.com/0/private/AddOrder): operation timed out); the request may have reached the exchange — verify its state before retrying

categories.description: Throttled by Kraken's server-side rate limiter. The CLI returns this error immediately with no internal retry. The error includes a suggestion field with specific guidance and a docs_url linking to the relevant Kraken documentation.
categories.agent_action: Read the suggestion field for tier-specific limits and recommended changes. Read docs_url for full documentation. Decide whether to retry, reduce request frequency, or switch to WebSocket streaming.

backoff_strategy.note: CLI does not retry rate limit errors. The agent decides retry timing based on the suggestion and docs_url fields.

common_causes: Short-lived orders triggering trading engine penalty

example_envelope.message: Spot REST API rate limit exceeded (EAPI:Rate limit exceeded).
example_envelope.suggestion: Wait 5-15 seconds before retrying. Reduce request frequency. Use WebSocket streaming instead of REST polling for real-time data.

categories.description: Input validation failed before the request was sent.
categories.agent_action: Fix input parameters. Check types, required fields, allowed values.
common_causes: Insufficient workspace funds (paper capital or live allocation ledger)

example_envelope.message: Validation error: Invalid URL: invalid authority

categories.description: Configuration error. Config file missing, malformed, or invalid.
categories.agent_action: Check config file. For agents, prefer environment variables.

Spot streams self-heal: the CLI reconnects with paced exponential backoff (capped, jittered) until interrupted, and drops a subscription rejected again on a fresh token. `futures ws` stops with this error after 12 consecutive failed reconnects; restart it if you still need the feed. For one-shot order methods the envelope's `verify_first` field is the verdict: `"verify_first": true` means the request may have reached the exchange — confirm via open-orders/query-orders before resubmitting. Envelopes without `verify_first` failed before anything was sent and are safe to retry. The message prose restates the verdict ('verify its state before retrying') for older parsers.

backoff_strategy.note: Spot streams reconnect until interrupted, with no retry cap. `futures ws` waits 1s to 30s (plus jitter) between attempts and gives up after 12 consecutive failed reconnects; a connection that stays up for 30s resets the count. One-shot ws methods do not retry past their own timeout.

common_causes: Server closed without replying (one-shot: verify order state before retrying)

example_envelope.message: WebSocket error: no reply arrived; the request may have reached the exchange — verify its state before retrying

categories.description: An operation did not complete within its time budget: `kraken session stop` waited for the recorder to release its recording lock after SIGTERM, a WebSocket token request got no answer, or a browser sign-in was not finished in time.
categories.agent_action: Re-run the command. If `session stop` keeps timing out, check `kraken session show` — the recorder may still be flushing a large tape, or may have ignored the signal.

backoff_strategy.note: The CLI does not auto-retry. The agent decides when to re-run based on whether the underlying operation is still making progress.

common_causes: Recorder still checkpointing a large tape
Browser sign-in not completed in time

example_envelope.message: Timeout: session s3 recorder (pid 4242) was signalled but still holds its recording lock after 10s; it may still be flushing.

categories.description: Failed to parse API response. Response not valid JSON or unexpected structure.
categories.agent_action: Log raw response. Possible API change or maintenance. Do not retry.
